import importlib.util, os, tempfile, tomllib, json

spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("cfg", "src/flask/config.py")
m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(m)

d = tempfile.mkdtemp()
open(os.path.join(d, "config.toml"), "wb").write(b'TEST_KEY="foo"\nSECRET_KEY="config"\n')

c = m.Config(root_path=d)
assert c.from_file("config.toml", tomllib.load, text=False) is True
assert c["TEST_KEY"] == "foo" and c["SECRET_KEY"] == "config"
print("from_file text=False + tomllib.load ->", dict(c))

json.dump({"TEST_KEY": "bar"}, open(os.path.join(d, "config.json"), "w"))
c2 = m.Config(root_path=d)
c2.from_file("config.json", json.load)
assert c2["TEST_KEY"] == "bar"
print("default text=True + json.load ->", dict(c2))

try:
    m.Config(root_path=d).from_file("config.toml", tomllib.load)
except TypeError as e:
    print("text=True with tomllib.load raises TypeError as expected")
PY
